steps.describes: Prepares the CX-201 data with the protocol's dose (25 mg IV bolus).
steps.rationale: The data file has no dose column; the protocol fixes it.

steps.describes: NCA after the IV bolus: AUC (back-extrapolated to 0), terminal half-life, AUC to infinity, clearance.
steps.rationale: Clearance and half-life answer the development plan's question directly.

steps.describes: run001: two compartments after an IV bolus (SSbiexp), random effects on both amplitudes.
steps.rationale: Two phases are visible in every subject; one compartment would miss the distribution phase.

steps.describes: Once-daily dosing at 25, 50 and 100 mg simulated to steady state from run001.
steps.rationale: The development plan asks whether once daily is plausible: the trough at 100 mg is near zero, so it is not.

steps.describes: Independent rerun of Carla's THP-102 food-effect step on her NCA table.
steps.rationale: QC of the THP-102 result before it goes into the project report.

claims.why: independent QC of the THP-102 analysis dataset
